newsitem.title: USA: U.S. returns to standard time on Sunday.
newsitem.headline: U.S. returns to standard time on Sunday.

text.p: The United States returns to standard time Sunday for the next five months when clocks are turned back one hour at 2 a.m. (0600 GMT) in each time zone.
Daylight savings time returns on April 6, 1997. Daylight time is in effect from the first Sunday in April until the last Sunday in October.
